fields.label: Device Name
fields.description: Any name you choose, such as main-entrance. It is saved on every check-in this device creates.

fields.label: Device IP Address
fields.description: The address of the device on your network, such as 192.168.1.201. Port 4370 is used.

fields.label: Device Password
fields.description: Only if your device has a numeric communication key. Most do not - leave it empty.

fields.label: In or Out
fields.description: AUTO works for almost everyone. Use IN or OUT only for a device that records one direction. None leaves it blank.

fields.label: Check Every (Minutes)
fields.description: How long to wait before reading this device again on the hourly schedule.

fields.label: Last Read
fields.description: Filled in automatically. Clear it to make the next scheduled run read this device.
